title: India Calls AJK Election a 'Farce'; Pakistan Says India Lacks 'Moral Authority' to Comment
detail: India's Ministry of External Affairs termed the completed Azad Jammu & Kashmir Assembly election a 'farce,' saying such 'hollow exercises' could not hide the ground reality in Pakistan-administered Kashmir. Pakistan's Foreign Office rejected the criticism as baseless and politically motivated on August 7, 2026, stating India had 'neither the standing nor the moral authority' to comment on AJK's polls, which it described as peaceful, transparent, and reflective of the democratic will of the people. The Foreign Office spokesperson noted India's remarks came on the eve of the Youm-e-Istehsal anniversary and accused New Delhi of trying to distract from its own actions in Indian-administered Jammu & Kashmir.

media.caption: Pakistan's Foreign Office rejects India's characterization of the AJK election as a 'farce'

title: NIA Chargesheets 2 in Pakistan-Linked Plot to Bomb Passenger Train, Smuggle Arms and Heroin
detail: India's National Investigation Agency filed a chargesheet before the NIA Special Court in Mohali on August 7-8, 2026 against two men — Shubham Kumar (in custody) and Jasvir Chaudhary (absconding) — over a cross-border conspiracy run by a Pakistan-based handler and associates in India to smuggle arms, explosives, and narcotics across the border. The case began in February 2026 when Amritsar's State Special Operations Cell arrested Kumar in possession of a live IED in a metallic case, a remote-control detonator, a foreign-made .30 bore pistol with 20 live cartridges, a mobile phone, and heroin; the NIA took over the probe in March. Investigators say Kumar was tasked with planting a timer-activated IED on a passenger train, with the broader plot envisaging attacks at multiple locations including Punjab and New Delhi. Both accused are charged under the UAPA, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Explosive Substances Act, Arms Act, NDPS Act, and Railways Act; the investigation into the wider smuggling network and additional operatives continues.

media.caption: NIA chargesheets two men in a Pakistan-linked plot to bomb a passenger train and smuggle arms and heroin across the border
